title: GNN-based Path-aware multi-view Circuit Learning for Technology Mapping
abstract: arXiv:2601.14286v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Traditional technology mapping suffers from systemic inaccuracies in delay estimation due to its reliance on abstract, technology-agnostic delay models that fail to capture the nuanced timing behavior behavior of real post-mapping circuits. To address this fundamental limitation, we introduce GPA(graph neural network (GNN)-based Path-Aware multi-view circuit learning), a novel GNN framework that learns precise, data-driven delay predictions by synergistically fusing three complementary views of circuit structure: And-Inverter Graphs (AIGs)-based functional encoding, post-mapping technology emphasizes critical timing paths. Trained exclusively on real cell delays extracted from critical paths of industrial-grade post-mapping netlists, GPA learns to classify cut delays with unprecedented accuracy, directly informing smarter mapping decisions. Evaluated on the 19 EPFL combinational benchmarks, GPA achieves 19.9%, 2.1% and 4.1% ave

translated_title: 基于图神经网络的路径感知多视图电路学习技术映射方法
translated_abstract: 传统技术映射由于依赖抽象的、与工艺无关的延迟模型，无法捕捉真实映射后电路的细微时序行为，因此在延迟估计上存在系统性的不准确。为了解决这一根本性局限，我们提出了GPA（基于图神经网络的路径感知多视图电路学习），这是一种新颖的图神经网络框架，通过协同融合电路结构的三种互补视图来学习精确的、数据驱动的延迟预测：基于与-非图（AIG）的功能编码、映射后工艺视图，并强调关键时序路径。GPA完全使用从工业级映射后网表的关键路径中提取的真实单元延迟进行训练，学会以前所未有的精度对切割延迟进行分类，从而直接支持更智能的映射决策。在19个EPFL组合电路基准测试上的评估中，GPA分别实现了19.9%、2.1%和4.1%的平均改进（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种基于图神经网络的路径感知多视图电路学习框架GPA，通过融合AIG功能编码与映射后工艺等多视图信息，并利用工业级映射后网表关键路径的真实单元延迟进行训练，实现了高精度延迟预测，显著提升了技术映射质量。
en_tdlr: GPA is a novel GNN-based path-aware multi-view circuit learning framework that fuses AIG functional encoding and post-mapping technology views, trained on real cell delays from industrial post-mapping netlists, to achieve accurate delay prediction and significantly improve technology mapping quality.
